source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Sprawling or trailing annual vine with axillary tendrils
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate generally twice ternately compound with toothed or lobed leaflets
morphology_documented.flowers: ~4 mm, four unequal obovate petals, four sepals (two larger, two small), eight stamens
morphology_documented.fruit: Membranous inflated 3-lobed 3-celled capsule 3–4.5 cm wide, mature seeds black about 5 mm with contrasting pale attachment
